name: Kids Go Free at the Christchurch Gondola
description: KidsFest offer: up to three children go free with each paying adult. Ride to the summit for scenic trails, the audio-visual Discovery Ride, a cafe and gift shop.

name: Kids Go Free at the Christchurch Tram
description: KidsFest offer: up to three children free with a paying adult. All-day hop-on hop-off pass across 18 stops including the Margaret Mahy playground, Art Gallery and Turanga.

name: Parakiore Holiday Programme
description: Active, supervised days of sport, swimming and games at the city's new rec centre. Drop-off 8.30-9am, pick-up 3.30-4pm. Community Services / Hapai Access card discounts available.

name: School Holiday Mountain Biking
description: Coached mountain-biking days building confidence and bike-handling on the Port Hills. Riders should be comfortable at beginner level. Optional lunch ($12) and bike hire ($25).

name: Around the World Holiday Programme
provider: Air Force Museum of New Zealand
description: Each day explores a different country the RNZAF has visited, with hands-on activities, crafts and stories. Held at the museum in Wigram.

name: Orana Wildlife Park - Miniature Moo Encounter
description: Get up close with miniature cattle and other friendly animals at New Zealand's only open-range zoo. Part of the KidsFest programme.

name: Imagination Station at Turanga
description: Free drop-in making sessions at Turanga - holiday brick school, movie making and more. Check the Imagination Station page for session times and to book a spot.

name: The Reluctant Dragon
description: A charming family theatre show for the winter holidays. A gentle, book-loving dragon would rather write poetry than fight knights.

name: UV Roller Disco
description: Glow-in-the-dark roller skating to music in a fun, supervised session. Skates available. A high-energy KidsFest favourite.

name: Try Self Defence
description: A free taster session teaching the basics of self defence, confidence and body awareness in a safe, encouraging environment.

name: Pirates and Mermaids Adventure - Lincoln
description: Dress up and join a playful pirates-and-mermaids treasure adventure with games, crafts and stories for younger kids.

name: Cantonese Culture Children's Festival 2026
description: A family celebration of Cantonese culture with performances, food, craft and activities for tamariki of all ages.

name: School Holiday Donut Decorating
description: Decorate delicious donuts with frosting, sprinkles and toppings to take home, then decorate a box to carry them in. Two 45-minute sessions (10am and 11am) — choose yours when booking. Held at Kin Bistro, ground floor.

name: School Holiday Donut Decorating
description: Decorate delicious donuts with frosting, sprinkles and toppings to take home, then decorate a box to carry them in. Two 45-minute sessions (10am and 11am) — choose yours when booking. Held at Kin Bistro, ground floor.

name: Meet a K-Pop Demon Hunter Superfan
description: Make a custom charm bracelet and decorated keepsake box, add hair glitter, meet a character, and learn a simple routine at a mini dance party. Two 45-minute sessions (10am and 11am) — choose yours when booking.

name: Meet a K-Pop Demon Hunter Superfan
description: Make a custom charm bracelet and decorated keepsake box, add hair glitter, meet a character, and learn a simple routine at a mini dance party. Two 45-minute sessions (10am and 11am) — choose yours when booking.

name: Junior Keeper Programme
description: Spend a full day working alongside a keeper feeding and caring for animals and birds. Lunch and a Willowbank hat included. Runs on selected days these July holidays — pick your date when booking.

name: Junior Keeper Plus
description: All the Junior Keeper activities plus bees and beekeeping instruction. Full day, with lunch and a Willowbank hat included. Runs on selected days these July holidays — pick your date when booking.

name: Free Kids DIY Workshop
description: Free hands-on woodworking and craft projects, with a new theme each session. Recommended for ages 3-12; booking is compulsory. Runs at Riccarton (64 Blenheim Rd), Christchurch Airport and Shirley stores, among others. Bunnings releases sessions about two weeks ahead, so check your store page for the exact July dates and to book.

name: Monty the Monkey Craft & Discovery
description: Free craft and discovery activities for younger kids with Monty the Monkey. Drop in and book a 20-minute session at Centre Court on the day. Runs daily through the July school holidays, 10.30am-2.30pm.

name: Tall Tails Museum Hunt
provider: Air Force Museum of New Zealand
description: Explore the Tall Tails exhibition then hunt for animal tails hidden through the museum. Completed hunts go in a draw to win a C-130H Hercules tour with a pilot. Drop in any time.

name: Twigarella Puddlenip's Great Hero Hunt
description: Join a quirky green witch on a magical trail through the Botanic Gardens, discovering native plants with storytelling, games and hands-on activities. Free, drop in any time.

name: KidsFest under the Stars
description: See stars, clusters and nebulae through telescopes at the West Melton observatory with experienced astronomers. Runs on selected nights and is weather-dependent, so check cas.org.nz by 6pm. Tickets $10-$17 and sell out fast.

name: Telling Tales KidsFest Treasure Hunt
description: Pick up an entry form and tick off the characters as you spot them around the bookshop, then go in a draw to win books. Free, drop in any time.

name: Telling Tales Reading Challenge
description: Collect an entry form, read any books you like over the holidays, and return the form in-store to claim a goody bag. Free, all ages.

name: Design-Your-Own Book Cover
description: Pick up an entry form and design your brightest, most original book cover these school holidays. Free, drop in any time.

name: Did they really do that? Cantabrians quest for world records
description: A popup exhibition exploring Cantabrians' bold endeavours to break world records in the 1970s-80s.

name: Pooh Bear LIVE
description: An interactive family show with live music dancing magic and audience participation.

name: Kids at Church for Kidsfest
description: A KidsFest church service with choir music drama balloons and entertainment for children.

name: Fun Dumpling Workshop
description: Learn to make vegetarian dumplings with a Japanese tutor and take home ten dumplings.

name: Secret Ukulele Society
description: An introduction to ukulele where kids master the basics and jam along to popular songs.

name: Ferrymead Signal Seekers
description: Hands-on activities exploring how people communicated before smartphones including morse code and telephone building.

name: Matariki Code Quest - Kaiapoi
description: Make a Matariki quiz on Scratch while learning coding fundamentals.

name: OYCH Ōtautahi Youth Circus Hui
description: A circus festival offering workshops in general and specialised circus skills for kids and youth.

name: Mahjong for Teens 10-18 years

name: Ready Set Read! 4-6 years

name: Elements Work and Play 2yrs-7yrs

name: The Mini Disco Experience 2-6yr olds

name: Active Kids Kickstart Karate Age 6-12
description: An entry-level karate class with techniques games and foam nunchaku training.

name: Airclay Toadies Bugs and Hanging Jellyfish

name: Makey Makey Music with Scratch Age 8-10 years

name: SPIKE Prime Explorer

name: Robots in Cold Places

name: Boys Dance and Gymnastics Workshop
description: Workshop for boys interested in dance and gymnastics with fitness and freestyle sessions.

name: LEGO WeDo 2.0 Explorer

name: Hibernation Haven

name: Try Judo

name: Cuddle Creatures

name: Fudge Decorating

name: Dinosaurs After Dark

name: Fudge Spectacular
description: Design and create your ultimate fudge masterpiece in a 30-minute hands-on workshop.

name: Learn to Ice Skate

name: Judo Skills Week
description: A weeklong intensive judo training camp led by an Olympic instructor.

name: Kids Fest Have-a-Go Gymnastics

name: Orana Wildlife Park Holiday Programme

name: Little Listeners Lounge

name: Active Kids Tigers Karate

name: My First Robotics

name: Kids Dance and Gymnastics Camp

name: Imagination Station Holiday Brick School

name: Inky Arts and Crafts at Ferrymead Print Shop

name: Canterbury Rams and Mainland Pouākai Holiday Camps

name: Composing Club

name: Use your art in activism

name: Te Hotera Karara Bug Hotels Journals Food in a Jar 5-15yrs

name: Fairy Jars

name: Teen Book Club

name: Underwater Wonderland

name: Matariki Night Sky
description: A family-friendly canvas painting session with all materials included.

name: Whanau Board Games

name: Matariki Pool Party
description: A two-hour water-based celebration with star-themed games and family activities.
